title: Hydra — pipeline.yaml
description: Job wiring: which source feeds which destination.

pipeline.description: A Hydra job connects exactly one source to one destination. Only 'from' and 'to' drive execution; Hydra Studio also writes 'name' and 'transformations', which the engine ignores.

from.description: Identifier of a source declared in sources.yaml. Must match a key of the 'sources' section exactly.

to.description: Identifier of a destination declared in destinations.yaml. Must match a key of the 'destinations' section exactly.

name.description: Written by Hydra Studio for readability. The engine does not read it.

transformations.description: Written by Hydra Studio to point at the transformations section. The engine reads transformations.yaml regardless.
